army_rules.name: Curse of the Wulfen
army_rules.rules_text:
While this unit is within 6" of a friendly SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER model (excluding WULFEN models) or within 12" of a friendly WOLF PRIEST model, this unit is not Battle-shocked. If this unit has INFANTRY, this unit has +1 OC. If this unit has VEHICLE, this unit has +3 OC.

Bestial Forms: For the purposes of transport capacity, each WULFEN model takes up the space of 2 models.

chapter_rules.name: Sons of Russ
chapter_rules.rules_text: The Great Companies of the Space Wolves are renowned for their ferocity and steadfast loyalty to the Imperium.
bullet_points: If an Adeptus Astartes unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit's Chapter.
You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.
If your army uses any of the Detachments from this book, it can include Space Wolves units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.
chapter_rules.designer_note: The rules presented in this section assume that the Adeptus Astartes units in your army are from the Space Wolves Chapter, but they can also be used to represent any Space Wolves successor Chapter, such as one described in the background section of this book, or even one of your own invention.

rule.name: The Great Wolf Watches

rule.name: Master of Wolves
rule.rules_text: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) with Howling Onslaught gain the following: Encircling Jaws: if Assault doctrine is active, +1 to Advance and Charge rolls; Hunter's Eye: if Devastator doctrine is active, ranged attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1; Ferocious Strike: if Tactical doctrine is active, attacks that target an enemy unit with 9 inches have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

additional_rules.name: Howling Onslaught
additional_rules.rules_text: Friendly LOGAN GRIMNAR units have Howling Onslaught: Once per battle, per army, in your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MONSTER/VEHICLE units benefit from Master of Wolves until the start of your next Command phase.

restrictions: Your army can include SPACE WOLVES units, but cannot include ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Grimnar's Mark
enhancements.rules_text: Once per battle round, per army, you can target this unit with the Rapid Ingress/Heroic Intervention Stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that Stratagem this phase. If you do, that use is -1CP and does not prevent any uses of that Stratagem on other units this phase.
